title: Where Cursive Text Works: Discord, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, Facebook and More
seoTitle: Where Cursive Text Works: Discord, TikTok, X, WhatsApp & More
description: A platform-by-platform guide to cursive text: which apps show it in names, bios, posts and messages, where it gets stripped, and which style to use on each.
excerpt: Cursive text behaves differently on every platform. This guide covers Discord, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, Facebook, YouTube, Roblox and email: where it shows, where it is stripped, and which style to pick.
lede: The same cursive text can be a display name on Discord, a caption on TikTok and a rejected username on Roblox. Here is what each major platform does with it, field by field, so you know before you paste.

faq.q: Why does cursive text work in my display name but not my username?
faq.a: Usernames are identifiers, so almost every platform restricts them to plain letters, numbers and a few symbols to keep them typeable and unique. Display names are labels, not identifiers, so they accept any Unicode character the app can render.

faq.q: Does cursive text affect search or hashtags?
faq.a: Yes. Search treats 𝓬𝓾𝓻𝓼𝓲𝓿𝓮 and cursive as different strings, and hashtags made of cursive characters are usually not linked at all. Keep hashtags, @mentions, brand names and anything you want to be searchable in plain text.

faq.q: Can I use cursive text in Discord channel names?
faq.a: Server names and display names accept cursive freely. Text channel names are lowercased and limited to letters, numbers, dashes and underscores, so cursive is stripped; voice channel names and category names are more permissive.

faq.q: Which cursive style works on the most platforms?
faq.a: Bold Cursive. Its characters come from a single Unicode block that current iOS, Android, Windows and macOS all render, so it survives on every platform that allows Unicode at all. Use it when you are unsure.
